_doc: Proposed performance budget (card 0362; Context/translation-pipeline/chunking-design.md, 'The budget'). Benchmarks/perf/check_budget.py compares a run_perf.py result (summary.json, else each engine's timers_n2c.csv) with these limits and exits non-zero on any breach. Times are wall-clock ms on the reference machine of performance-baseline.md and were set from a run taken under load: tighten them after a quiet-window rerun. A limit whose metric a run did not record is reported as not measured, never as a pass or a breach. Owner decision: card 0363.
